lines.text: From Kadesh, Moses sent messengers to the king of Edom, calling Israel his brother.
The message said the Egyptians mistreated their fathers, and the LORD sent a raven to bring them out of Egypt.
Israel asked to pass through Edom's land and promised to stay on the King's Highway.
Edom threatened Israel with the sword, so Israel offered to pay for any water and pass through on horseback.
Edom came out with a large army and refused, and Israel turned away from them.
